tweet.text:
Once I got involved in guiding the architecture, all the pieces fell into place.  I have a nice layered architecture now, with dependencies all well managed.  I built a tool to check those dependencies on every test run.  I also built a tool to help me visualize the architecture.  

Conclusion: Architecture remains, so far, in the realm of human judgement.  AIs, as intelligent and insightful as they appear to be, do not have that level of insight and judgement.  

Bottom line: Don't trust the AIs to create the architecture.  They'll just muddy the waters.
